episodes.158025: There was an EF-0 tornado that touched down in Tehama County on Sunday evening around 5:45 pm in the town of Capay, just north of Orland and the Glenn County border. This was video-recorded by a resident in a nearby field between Watkins Rd. and Capay Rd. No damage was observed in this 15 second touchdown.||The tornado touched down again about 2 miles to the east, on Post Ave between 4th and 5th Avenues. Minor damage was reported at 2 homes, including a damaged carport, roof tiles, sheds, and trees. There were also around 40 orchard trees damaged or uprooted.
